independentObservations.R-W08-1: Deferred save assertions observe checkbox, module count, prerequisite/next badges and unchanged lecture HTTP count. Real browser independently reads PostgreSQL on save/failed unmark/rollback/successful unmark while A remains open.
independentObservations.R-W08-2: Five heading forms sent through actual Lecture3UseCase and HTTP/SSE; first text arrives before fake model finishes, answer absent then collapsed at final, opens on user action. Received React tests independently inject full raw deltas, so future SA70 filtering cannot make those web guards vacuous.
independentObservations.finalNull: Four React cases and one actual HTTP/PG browser case preserve the complete final text if core cannot split a self-check.
independentObservations.counterexamples: 15 exact-source guard proofs: eight unchanged backend sources and seven refreshed UI mutants, all assertion failures with native exit 1 and byte restoration.
